page_title: CM L: Staff vs Sabers - part 2 - SaberCraft
prose: CM-L expands the staff lesson into the SaberCraft framework. In this lesson, two lumens are matched up saber versus staff just like in CM-K. Notation below for Lumen 2 - Staff is noted with which hand is used to strike with the staff. L stands for Left. R stands for Right hand. Hand positions are up to the Lumeneer but we recommend Right-hand palm facing down and Left-hand palm facing up.
